midi.title: MIDI Settings
midi.no_inputs_body: Ensure devices are connected and powered on, then refresh.
midi.no_outputs_body: Verify connections or check device drivers.

micTest.title: Microphone Pitch Test
micTest.tipBody: Microphone pitch detection is an interim option for Acoustic Pianos or when cables are unavailable. For 100% latency-free accuracy, please connect your piano via USB MIDI or Bluetooth MIDI!
